title: Run credential call
description: The body of the control plane's call with the path run-credential, a POST of application/json to the adapter's call_url followed by run-credential (adapter.schema.json), signed as definitions.schema.json describes a call: an access credential for one run, under the grant grant_ref, for the resources, at the access level access, for the purpose purpose. grant_ref and each resource are as the adapter answered them to a resolve call (resolve-answer.schema.json). The adapter answers a signed 200 with run-credential-answer.schema.json, or refuses with refusal.schema.json, in this order: 409 grant_unknown, the adapter holds no grant grant_ref; 403 resource_not_covered, the grant does not cover one of the resources; 403 access_not_granted, the grant does not allow access for the resources, such as write under a grant that allows read alone; 503 source_unavailable, the source did not answer or was busy, and the control plane may send the call again later, built anew. How far one credential reaches is the description's credential_scope (description.schema.json). The adapter refuses a call whose time is more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, or whose signature it has already seen, with an unsigned 401; definitions.schema.json has the replay rule. A member this schema does not define is refused, invalid_request.

version.description: The document format. The adapter refuses a version it does not read.

time.description: When the control plane built the body, RFC 3339 in UTC with whole seconds. The adapter refuses a time more than 300 seconds from its clock, either way, with an unsigned 401.

grant_ref.description: The grant the credential is minted under, as the adapter reported it (grant.schema.json).

resources.description: The resources the credential covers, 1 to 64, none twice, each a resource_ref as the adapter answered it to a resolve call.

access.description: read, or write: the access level the run has on the resources, the access of the run's documents (run/v1 documents.schema.json).

purpose.description: harness, a credential the run uses to fetch what composes its harness; or work, a credential the run uses for its work on the resources.
